title: Purely inseparable base change and reduction of the tensor factors
statement: Let $k$ be a separably closed field [def-kun-separably-closed], and $K/k,L/k$ field extensions [def-pc-field-extension]. Put $\Omega=\overline{k}$, $A=\Omega\otimes_k K$, $B=\Omega\otimes_k L$, $R=A/\sqrt{0}$ and $S=B/\sqrt{0}$. Then $R,S$ are domains and $\operatorname{Spec}(K\otimes_k L)$ is homeomorphic to $\operatorname{Spec}(R\otimes_\Omega S)$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma 00I7, first and second paragraphs

proof.text: Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isPurelyInseparable_of_isSepClosed makes the algebraic closure purely inseparable. PrimeSpectrum.isHomeomorph_comap_of_isPurelyInseparable, followed by tensor commutation, identifies the spectra of each base-changed field with its original field. Each is irreducible; PrimeSpectrum.irreducibleSpace_iff_isPrime_nilradical makes its nilradical prime. Quotienting by that prime gives a domain.

For a nil ideal I, PrimeSpectrum.isHomeomorph_comap applied to the quotient map gives a homeomorphism on spectra: every quotient element is in the image and the kernel lies in the nilradical. The image of a nilradical under includeRight generates a nil ideal, since nilpotence is preserved by ring homomorphisms. tensorQuotientEquiv therefore gives a homeomorphism after reducing the right tensor factor.

Purely inseparable base change gives Spec(K tensor_k L) homeomorphic to Spec(Omega tensor_k (K tensor_k L)). cancelBaseChange and assoc identify the latter ring with A tensor_Omega B. Reduce B by the preceding step, commute the tensor factors, reduce A, and commute again. Compose the resulting homeomorphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem IsSepClosed.tensor_reduction_domains_homeomorph
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [IsSepClosed k]
    (K : Type v) [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (L : Type w) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    let Ω := AlgebraicClosure k
    let R := (Ω ⊗[k] K) ⧸ nilradical (Ω ⊗[k] K)
    let S := (Ω ⊗[k] L) ⧸ nilradical (Ω ⊗[k] L)
    IsDomain R ∧ IsDomain S ∧
      Nonempty (PrimeSpectrum (K ⊗[k] L) ≃ₜ PrimeSpectrum (R ⊗[Ω] S))
